subject.title: fix(browser): support GPT-5.6 Sol Pro effort

question: Should Oracle expose `pro` as a persistent CLI, configuration, and MCP thinking-time value that fails closed for every target except selected GPT-5.6 Sol?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound, but this creates a new public configuration capability and an intentional compatibility policy for inherited mixed-model workflows that code review alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Accept strict Pro contract
options.body: Keep `pro` across CLI, configuration, and MCP and reject incompatible model or strategy combinations before browser acquisition.

options.title: Limit persistent inheritance
options.body: Support explicit per-run Pro requests while preventing an inherited global Pro value from blocking incompatible model runs.

options.title: Defer to picker redesign
options.body: Pause this surface until maintainers resolve the broader model-inventory direction in https://github.com/steipete/oracle/pull/319.

recommendation.title: Accept strict Pro contract
recommendation.body: Keep `pro` across CLI, configuration, and MCP and reject incompatible model or strategy combinations before browser acquisition.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent GPT-5.6 release, browser-picker history, configuration-precedence work, and release ownership make this the strongest available decision owner.
